below before requesting review.
-->

## Summary

<!-- Describe the change and its motivation. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor / tooling

## Mathematical changes

<!-- Required only if this PR changes calculations or adds numerical routines. -->

- [ ] I have added or updated tests with explicit reference values.
- [ ] I have documented tolerances used for floating-point comparisons.
- [ ] I have cited a reference (textbook, paper, or derivation) for the formula.

## Quality checklist

- [ ] `ruff format --check .` passes
- [ ] `ruff check .` passes
- [ ] `mypy` passes
- [ ] `pytest` passes with coverage
- [ ] I have not included any secrets, credentials, or confidential data
- [ ] I have not committed generated environments or build output
